description: (needs account token) Renames the main email address of a site's domain, for example hello@ to info@. Same mailbox, same mail, same price. confirm=true applies it.

address.description: The new part before the @, e.g. "info".

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: rename_main_inbox
title: Rename main inbox
